meta.title: Temp Chat (temporary questions)
meta.description: Ask /single-turn for a one-shot answer and /multi-turn to continue the same temporary thread. Answers come from an isolated subagent with web search, are shown in this conversation, and never enter the main model context.

singleTurn.description: Single-turn temp question: a fresh subagent researches the web and answers; no prior context, and the answer never enters the main model context

multiTurn.description: Continue the last temp topic: replays the Q&A since /single-turn and answers again; the answer also stays out of the main model context

command.empty: Type your question, e.g. /{command} what's in the news today?

answer.noAgent: The command did not carry an agent; cannot locate the current session.
answer.noRegistry: The host has no agentPresets service: the DSH runtime is too old, or the current composition lacks a preset registry.
answer.providerMissing: Subagent provider "{provider}" is not registered. Available: {available}
answer.providerNoPreset: Provider "{provider}" does not support agentPreset composition, so the temp-chat persona and tool scope cannot be applied; set the provider to spawn.
answer.startTimeout: Timed out ({seconds}s) before the subagent could start.
answer.runTimeout: Timed out ({seconds}s) and was cancelled. Retry, or split the question into smaller ones.
answer.notFinished: The subagent did not finish normally ({stopReason}).
answer.noText: The subagent returned no text answer.
answer.noThread: > Note: there is no temp topic to continue, so this was answered as a new topic.

preset.name: Temp Q&A (plugin internal)
preset.description: Preset composed for dsh-temp-chat subagents; not meant for manual selection in regular sessions
